verdict.rationale: Agent identity is a fair question for an enterprise identity provider like Entra ID, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents treating AI agents as first-class identities, cross-app access for agents, token vaulting, or scoped agent credentials. The general application-management item (docs-16, covering permissions, tokens and certificates for apps) is an adjacent feature, not agent identity. The MCP probe concerns a Learn docs server, not securing agent access to apps.
